WITCHBLADE.CapWarn: Ferality cap reached. Make the Blood Surge save. Fail and you enter Feral State for 1d4 rounds plus 1 per point over the cap.
WITCHBLADE.ActionAssumed: The rules don't state an action type; treated as an Action.
WITCHBLADE.EmptyFilter: No techniques match this filter at your current FP.
WITCHBLADE.EmptySurge: Activate Blood Surge to use surge techniques.
WITCHBLADE.SurgeActive: Blood Surge active: +5 {stat}, melee +{dice}d4 force, advantage on STR checks and saves.
WITCHBLADE.SurgeIdle: Blood Surge: +5 {stat}, melee +{dice}d4 force, 1 minute, {uses} uses per short rest.

Chat.SurgeEnds: The Blood Surge effect is removed.
Chat.SurgeOn: +5 {stat}, melee attacks +{dice}d4 force, advantage on STR checks and saves. Surge techniques unlocked.
Chat.CapHeld: You keep control until the end of your next turn.
Chat.FeralOn: You lose control for {rounds} rounds. Resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, and advantage on melee attacks (apply the advantage when rolling).
Chat.FeralEnds: Gain 2 levels of exhaustion (now {exhaustion}). FP resets to 0 and Blood Surge ends.
Chat.FeralSoftEnd: FP dropped below the cap before a successful save. You come out of Feral State and keep your FP, with no exhaustion.
Chat.FeralTurn: Feral turn {n} of {total}. Instability decides this turn's course of action.
Chat.CalmFailed: You fail to calm down. FP is now {fp}.
Chat.SaveSkipped: You gained FP this turn, so there's no end-of-turn save.
Chat.CombatEndedFeral: Combat ended while in Feral State. Use Calm down on the Ferality tab: make a Blood Surge save each round until you succeed or your FP falls below the cap.

Warn.SurgeLevel: Blood Surge unlocks at Witch-Blade level 2.
Warn.NoUses: No Blood Surge uses left. Take a short rest.
Warn.NoTable: No Rollable Table named "{name}" exists. Create one, or turn on "Create Witch-Blade tables" in the module settings and reload.

Dialog.Leave: Leave Blood Surge after this save
Dialog.GainedNote: You gained FP this turn. By the class rules this save is optional, so you can close this window.
Dialog.EndTurnText: Wisdom save. Success: reduce FP by 1. Failure: gain 1 FP and draw from Feral Instability.
Dialog.CapText: You're at {fp}/{cap} FP. On a success you keep control until the end of your next turn. On a failure you enter Feral State for 1d4{extra} rounds.
Dialog.CalmText: Blood Surge save to come out of Feral State. On a failure you roll Instability and lose 1 FP.

Info.Disabled: {name} is no longer marked as a Witch-Blade.

Item.BloodSurge: Bonus action. For 1 minute: +5 STR (DEX for Seekers), melee attacks deal extra force damage (1d4, +1d4 per proficiency increase), advantage on STR checks and saves, and access to surge techniques. Gain 1 FP. Uses equal to your proficiency bonus per short rest. Using this again ends the surge.
Item.EndTurnSave: At the end of each turn in Blood Surge, if you have not gained FP, you can make a DC 13 Wisdom save. Success: reduce FP by 1 and optionally end Blood Surge. Failure: gain 1 FP and roll on the Feral Instability table.
Item.CapSave: When you reach your Ferality cap, make a Wisdom save (DC 13 + 1 per FP over the cap). On a success you keep control until the end of your next turn. On a failure you enter Feral State for 1d4 rounds + 1 per FP over the cap. The module prompts for this automatically; use this to roll it by hand.
Item.Feral: Resistance to nonmagical damage and advantage on melee attacks. Roll on Feral Instability at the start of each turn. When it ends: 2 levels of exhaustion, FP resets to 0, roll a Feral Mutation.

WITCHBLADE.RemoveMutation: Remove mutation (for example after a Lysis purge)
WITCHBLADE.ToggleActor: Witch-Blade: turn on/off for this character

Banner.Cap: Ferality cap reached. Make the Ferality Cap Save at DC {dc}. If you fail, you enter Feral State for 1d4{extra} rounds.
Banner.Held: Control held until the end of your next turn. While you're at or over the cap, you roll on Feral Instability at the end of each turn.
Banner.Feral: Feral State: {rounds} of {total} rounds left. The DM controls your actions. Use Feral turn for each turn, or Calm down once combat is over.
Banner.FeralCombat: Feral State: {rounds} of {total} rounds left. The DM controls your actions. Instability is rolled at the start of each of your turns, and rounds count down at the end.

createTables.Name: Create Witch-Blade tables
createTables.Hint: When a GM loads the world, create the "Feral Instability" and "Feral Mutations" Rollable Tables if they don't exist.

techniqueItems.Name: Add surge techniques as feature items
techniqueItems.Hint: Adds each available surge technique to Witch-Blade characters as a feature item, so it shows in Argon Combat HUD and the Features tab. Blood Surge and the End-of-Turn Save are always added.

automateTurns.Name: Automate combat turns
automateTurns.Hint: In combat, run the Witch-Blade turn steps automatically: Feral Instability at the start of Feral turns, Feral rounds counting down, Instability and re-saves at the cap, and the end-of-turn save prompt.

promptEndTurn.Name: Prompt the end-of-turn save
promptEndTurn.Hint: At the end of a Witch-Blade's turn in Blood Surge, open the DC 13 Wisdom save dialog, unless she gained FP that turn. Needs 'Automate combat turns'.

tranceRest.Name: Trance reduces Ferality on
tranceRest.Hint: FP drops by half the Witch-Blade level when resting. Choose which rests count.
